draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.14, the 121st-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 5th of 12 at TE. He went 115th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 299 receiving yards in 2023, 9th of 12 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Cincinnati Bengals. 9 career games and 6 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 1 AV in 2024. Weak spots: receiving td 0 (15th percentile), season snap share 20.3% (18th percentile). Played 9 of 17 games in 2024. Versus the typical Year-1 tight end who played: 158 receiving yards against a median of 158 (level with).
